newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers off as buyers await lower prices.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers off as buyers await lower prices.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were a shade off on Wednesday as shipowners were anticipating prices to erode further, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst and 380-cst were quoted at $114 and $121 a tonne respectively, near the lower end of Tuesday's range as shipowners were still at a standoff, traders said.

Buyers were unwilling to buy as they expected prices to fall further on weakening cargo levels, traders said. But if cargo prices tipped higher later today, they might decide to buy, said a trader. MDO and gas oil eased to $225-$230 and $245-$248 a tonne respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
